{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or below) and recent prices show downward momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is negative and historical low prices are near or below 60.00.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility; smooth forecasts using 30-day moving average if sentiment is flat.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50+), allow slight upward bias but cap at 10% above recent peak.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, reduce forecast by 5-10% for next period to avoid overconfidence."
  ]
}
